# !KEEP LIST!
# nullenvironment — .env zones this toggle leaves untouched (dark/boss/story zones where
# removing the lighting would break visibility).
# Source of truth — edit freely (add or remove). Delete the file to restore the default.
# One rule per line. Bare = "contains" match, * = wildcard, # = comment.
#
# Examples (uncomment and adapt):
#   metadata/environmentsettings/maps/                 # keep a whole folder
#   *boss*                                             # keep anything containing "boss"
#   metadata/environmentsettings/maps/uberdoryani.env  # keep one exact file
